description: One portrait package on the Sessions page. Lists the fee, the time on location and what is included.

id.label: ID
id.help: Made from the title. It becomes the page address, so avoid changing it once the page is shared.

name.label: Name
name.help: Name of the package, e.g. Golden Hour Session.

price.label: Fee
price.help: The price in your currency, without the symbol.

length.label: Time on Location
length.help: How long you shoot, e.g. 90 minutes.

bestFor.label: Best For
bestFor.help: Who it suits, in a few words, e.g. couples and new families.

summary.label: Summary
summary.help: One or two sentences describing the session.

includes.label: What's Included
includes.help: One item per line, e.g. 40 edited photos. Shown as a list on the Sessions page.

image.label: Photo
image.help: A photo from a session like this one.

order.label: Order
order.help: Position in the fee table. Lower numbers come first.

featured.label: Show on Home Page
featured.help: Turn on to include this package in the fee table on the home page.

updated.label: Updated
updated.help: Set automatically when the object is saved.

created.label: Created
created.help: Set automatically when the object is created.
